features.title: Detective
features.text: Investigators solve problems with deduction and a very long list of skills, following leads to the heart of a mystery.

features.title: Devise a Stratagem
features.text: They roll an attack before making it and then decide whether to use it, turning knowledge into precise, well-timed strikes.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 3 → 3. Devise a Stratagem improves attack decisions; setup and alternative actions matter when the roll is poor.
ratings.defense: 2.5 → 2.5. Light armor and eight HP make avoiding unnecessary exposure valuable.
ratings.support: 3 → 2.5–4. Methodology and skill choices can emphasize medicine, knowledge or assisting allies.
ratings.utility: 5 → 5. Extra skills, leads and investigative abilities make information gathering a defining strength.
ratings.difficulty: 4 → 4. Follow leads and plan useful alternatives when the predicted attack is unfavorable.
